svg.title: Top view layout of the self-aligning fiber coupling bench
svg.desc: Laser at left fires right through crossed polarizers and a beamsplitter that picks off a reference photodiode, then hits motorized mirror M1 which folds the beam upward to motorized mirror M2, which folds it right through two irises, an aspheric lens on a micrometer stage, and into an FC bulkhead. The fiber loops to an output bulkhead with a photodiode. A camera swaps into the lens position for phase 1.
svg.text: Asphere f 8 mm on micrometer stage
Beam height about 25 mm above the printed base. Overall footprint roughly 420 x 260 mm.
